newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia-French recall only affects Milupa product.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia-French recall only affects Milupa product.

text.p: Dutch food group Nutricia NV said on Monday the withdrawal of baby food from French shops only concerned the "Lemiel 2" brand made by its Milupa unit in Colmar and all others products were unaffected.

Earlier the company said packs of "Lemiel 2" made in July 1996 had been withdrawn in consultation with the French authorities after the discovery of two cases of salmonella in September and October last year.
It described the move as "a precaution", adding that no new cases of salmonella had since come to light.
"This only concerns the "Lemiel 2" brand and we are confident we have withdrawn a fully safe product," Klaas de Jong, a spokesman for Nutricia said.
